name: Tierra Agrotech Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2012, Tierra Agro 
Ltd is in the business of Seed Research, 
Production, Processing and Marketing 
of Seeds and related products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is into research, development, production, processing and commercialization 
 of superior products in major crops like Cotton, Paddy, Rice, Corn, Mustard, Tomato, Hot Pepper, Okra, Soya Beans, Fodder Crops, etc.
